title.narrative: Zimbabwe Electoral Commission Capacity Building Project Phase Two (ZIM-ECO2)

description.narrative:
The main objective of ZIM -ECO2 project is to enhance ZEC institutional and technical capacity to meet its mandate in the preparation and organisation of elections.

The project is articulated around these four outcome areas. It seeks to enhance the effectiveness of the Zimbabwe Electoral Commission by strengthening its capacity to put these principles into practice. It also aims to enhance accountability and inclusion in the electoral process by supporting the Electoral Commission¿s work in these areas as well of that of other stakeholders. It supports efforts for the electoral process to further peace and justice, by supporting collaboration between the relevant institutions and organizations, notably the Chapter 12 commissions. Bearing in mind the Covid-19 pandemic, the project¿s work in all these outcome areas will also support ZEC and other electoral stakeholders to adjust to the new context.
